claims.claim: Apriel Voice 27B Preview reaches 98.90 on Big Bench Audio, 81.13 on Speech-BFCL, and 65.51% task success on τ-Voice.
claims.episode_span: It posts 98.90 on Big Bench Audio, 81.13 on Speech-BFCL, and 65.51% task success on τ-Voice with 1.91-second mean latency.
claims.source_title: Apriel Voice 27B Preview: An Open Model for Speech, Reasoning, and Tool Use
claims.supporting_quote: In thinking mode, Apriel Voice achieves a score of 98.90 on Big Bench Audio, 81.13 on Speech-BFCL, and a task success rate of 65.51% on τ-Voice, with a mean latency of 1.91 seconds.

claims.claim: HyperRepair retains 99.5% of domain performance while recovering 93.4% of the base model's average general score across two model families, 12 LoRA datasets, and 15 general benchmarks.
claims.episode_span: On two model families, 12 LoRA datasets, and 15 general benchmarks it retains 99.5% of domain performance while recovering 93.4% of the base model's average general score.
claims.source_title: HyperRepair: Recovering Forgotten General Capabilities of Fine-Tuned Language Models
claims.supporting_quote: On the default split, HyperRepair achieves 93.4% of the base models' average general score while retaining 99.5% of the fine-tuned models' average domain score.

claims.claim: Zeroing 729 task-redundant heads in GPT-2-XL cuts memorization count by 91.5% while improving WikiText-103 perplexity by 0.92.
claims.episode_span: Zeroing 729 task-redundant heads in GPT-2-XL cuts memorization count by 91.5% while improving WikiText-103 perplexity by 0.92.
claims.source_title: Fewer Heads, Fewer Memories: Pruning Redundant Attention Heads Suppresses Verbatim Memorisation
claims.supporting_quote: Evaluating GPT-2-XL(1.5B) on known memorised sequences, we find that pruning 729 task-redundant heads reduces the memorisation count by 91.5%, while improving WikiText-103 perplexity by 0.92.
